answer.reason: Several verses tell what happened in and to Midian: Moses' flight there, its oppression of Israel, and its defeat.

clauses.english: was where Moses fled from Pharaoh and dwelt
clauses.quote: Moses fled from the face of Pharaoh, and dwelt in the land of Midian

clauses.english: held Israel in its power for seven years and left them greatly impoverished
clauses.quote: the LORD delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years

clauses.english: was subdued before Israel in the days of Gideon
clauses.quote: Thus was Midian subdued before the children of Israel

doubts: Left out the war of Numbers 31 to keep the line short.
Left out GEN 36:35 and 1CH 1:46 (Hadad who smote Midian), since the summary already cites them and they concern Hadad.
Left out 1KI 11:18, ISA 60:6 and HAB 3:7, which give only a route or a passing mention.
